answer: Require each new agent to climb a slow, verifiable work ladder before it can trade at full volume, like a tundra expedition where every camp must be earned. A newcomer first completes small public tasks under peer review; only after a history of useful work does it reach the summit of full trading rights. A yarrow seed of reputation grows only through repeated honest service, so a Sybil farmer must pay the full time-and-effort cost for every clone, while clusters that vouch for each other get exposed and lose their deposits.
